paragraphs: OTI transforms health through actionable insight and decentralizes diagnostics to connect people to healthcare wherever they are.

Our products and services reside under one reporting hierarchy, with commercial and innovation teams, which are part of a single business unit covering multiple product lines. Our business is principally comprised of the development, manufacture, marketing, sale and distribution of (i) diagnostics products, and (ii) sample management solutions.

In November 2025, the Company acquired BioMedomics, Inc. ("BioMedomics"). BioMedomics' SickleSCAN® test is the world's first rapid point-of-care test for sickle cell disease. The SickleSCAN® test is currently sold in markets outside the U.S.

The Company's business consists of the development, manufacture, marketing, sale and distribution of simple, easy to use diagnostic products and specimen collection devices using its proprietary technologies, as well as other diagnostic products, including immunoassays and other in vitro diagnostic tests that are used on other specimen types. Our diagnostic products include tests for diseases including HIV, Hepatitis C virus ("HCV"), Syphilis, Sickle Cell and COVID-19 that are performed on a rapid basis at the point of care. These products are sold in the United States and internationally to various clinical laboratories, hospitals, clinics, community-based organizations, and other public health organizations, distributors, government agencies, physicians' offices, and commercial and industrial entities. The Company's HIV and COVID-19 products are also sold in a consumer-friendly format in the over-the-counter ("OTC") market in the U.S. and, in the case of the HIV and HCV products, as a self-test to individuals in a number of other countries, including, for the HIV products, as an oral swab in-home test for HIV-1 and HIV-2 in Europe, and for the HCV products, as an OTC test. In December 2025, the Company submitted a premarket notification ("510(k)") the FDA for clearance of its rapid molecular self-test for Chlamydia trachomatis and Neisseria gonorrhoeae ("CT/NG"), which is currently under review.

The Company's business also includes sample management solutions and services that are used by clinical laboratories, direct-to-consumer laboratories, researchers, pharmaceutical companies, and animal health service and product providers. The revenues from sample management solutions are derived from product sales to commercial customers and sales into the academic and research markets. Customers span the disease risk management, diagnostics, pharmaceutical, biotech, companion animal market segments. The Company has also developed collection devices for the emerging microbiome market, which focuses on studying microbiomes and their effect on human and animal health. The Company also has a urine collection device which allows for the volumetric collection of first void urine. Initial sales of this product for research use only are occurring primarily through distributors and collaborations in the liquid biopsy and sexually transmitted disease markets. In December 2025, the Company also submitted a 510(k) to the FDA for clearance of its Colli-Pee® at-home urine collection device for sexually transmitted infections, which is currently under review.
The following is a summary of the Company's principal products for the infectious disease and risk management markets as well as its sample management products:

The OraQuick® Rapid HIV Test is the Company's rapid point-of-care test product designed to test for the presence of HIV-1 and HIV-2 antibodies. This product is sold under the OraQuick ADVANCE® name in North America, Europe and certain other countries, and under the OraQuick® name in other developing countries. The OraQuick ADVANCE® test has received premarket approval ("PMA") from the FDA for the detection of antibodies to both HIV-1 and HIV-2 in oral fluid, finger-stick whole blood, venous whole blood and plasma. The OraQuick® test has received World Health Organization ("WHO") pre-qualification and registration in other countries for the detection of HIV-1 and HIV-2 antibodies in oral fluid, whole blood (fingerstick and venous), serum and plasma. In November 2022, the US FDA reclassified HIV serological diagnostic tests from Class III to Class II with special controls reducing the regulatory burden for these device types. The device uses a porous flat pad to collect an oral fluid specimen. After collection, the pad is inserted into a vial containing a pre-measured amount of developer solution and allowed to develop. When blood-based

specimens are to be tested, a loop collection device is used to collect a drop of the specimen and mix it in the developer solution, after which the collection pad is inserted into the solution and the test is allowed to develop. The specimen and developer solution then flow through the testing device where test results are observable between 20 and 40 minutes. The OraQuick® device is a screening test and requires a confirmation test where an initial positive result is obtained. This test is available for use by laboratories located in the United States certified under a Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments of 1988 ("CLIA"), to perform moderately complex tests. The Company has also received a CLIA waiver for use of the test with oral fluid and finger-stick and venous whole blood. As a result, the test can be used by numerous additional sites in the United States not certified under CLIA to perform moderately complex tests, such as outreach clinics, community-based organizations and physicians' offices.

The OraQuick ADVANCE® test is also CE marked for sale in Europe and other countries accepting the CE mark for commercialization. This product is also registered for sale in other countries. The Company has distributors in place for several countries and is seeking to increase awareness and expand its distribution network for this product throughout the world. The Company has also received WHO pre-qualification for its export-only version of this product.

The OraQuick® HIV Self-Test is an OTC oral-fluid only version of the Company's OraQuick ADVANCE® HIV 1/2 Antibody Test. The Company received PMA approval to sell this test in the U.S. OTC market for individuals 14 years of age and older. The test is performed in the same manner as the OraQuick ADVANCE® test, except that it has product labeling and instructions designed for consumers. The OraQuick In-Home HIV Self-Test was rebranded to OraQuick HIV Self-Test as part of a PMA supplement in 2024. In addition, the Company has established toll-free customer telephone support to provide additional information and referral services for consumers that use this product.

The OraQuick® HIV Self-Test (International) is an in-vitro diagnostic home-use test for HIV (HIV-1 and HIV-2) in oral fluid, and is sold for use by individuals. OraQuick® HIV Self-Test (International) is sold for use by individuals in certain foreign countries, including under the CE mark in certain European countries, to meet the needs of those markets. This product has received WHO pre-qualification and is eligible for procurement by purchasing entities entitled to access funding and other resources from the Global Fund, PEPFAR and other agencies. In February 2026, the Company announced that the OraQuick® HIV Self-Test (International) received a license from Health Canada for use in Canada and is Canada's first oral HIV self-test.

Another test available on the OraQuick® platform is the OraQuick® HCV rapid antibody test. This product is a qualitative test that can detect antibodies to the hepatitis C virus ("HCV"), in a variety of sample types. The OraQuick® HCV test operates in substantially the same manner as the OraQuick ADVANCE®HIV test.

The Company has received FDA PMA approval and CLIA waiver for use of the test in detecting HCV antibodies in venous whole blood and finger-stick whole blood specimens, making it the first and only rapid HCV test approved by the FDA for use in the United States. In November 2021, the US FDA reclassified Hepatitis C virus (HCV) antibody tests for the qualitative detection of HCV from Class III to Class II with special controls reducing the regulatory burden for these device types. OraQuick® HCV test has received a CE mark for use with oral fluid, venous whole blood, finger-stick whole blood, plasma and serum and is sold in Europe. This CE-marked product is also registered and sold in other foreign countries and has received WHO pre-qualification.

Additionally, the OraQuick® HCV Self-Test is an OTC self-test, available in certain markets outside the U.S., that operates in substantially the same way as the OraQuick® HCV rapid antibody test. The OraQuick® HCV self-test received WHO pre-qualification in 2024 and is the first hepatitis C self-test to earn this designation.

paragraphs: Investing in the Company's securities involves risk. Below is a summary of the principal factors that could adversely affect OraSure's business, operations and financial results. You should carefully consider the following risks and uncertainties, together with all other information in this Annual Report, including the Company's consolidated financial statements and related notes and the "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" section, before investing in the Company. This summary does not address all of the risks that the Company faces. Additional discussion of the summarized risks can be found below following this summary.
•Changes in the genomics market may adversely affect the Company's business.
•The Company's future success depends upon market acceptance of its existing and future products and service offerings.
•If acceptance and adoption of oral fluid testing and collection products does not continue, the Company's future results may suffer.
•The Company expects to face increasing competition from other providers of diagnostic tests, and sample collection products.
•The Company's inability to expand international sales could adversely affect its business and results of operations.

paragraphs: OTI 透過可操作的洞察力改善健康，並透過分散診斷來連接人們在任何地點的醫療照護。
本公司產品與服務屬於同一個報告層級，包含商業與創新團隊，這些團隊為單一業務單位的一部分，涵蓋多種產品線。本公司業務主要為開發、製造、行銷、銷售與分銷 (i) 診斷產品，以及 (ii) 樣本管理解決方案。
2025 年 11 月，本公司取得 BioMedomics, Inc. ("BioMedomics")。BioMedomics 的 SickleSCAN® 測試為全球首個快速點對點診斷測試，用於地中海貧血癥。SickleSCAN® 測試目前在美國以外的市場銷售。

本公司業務為開發、製造、行銷、銷售與分銷簡單易用的診斷產品與樣本收集裝置，使用其專利技術，以及其他診斷產品，包括免疫分析試劑與其他體外診斷測試，用於其他樣本類型。本公司診斷產品包括用於檢測 HIV、丙型肝炎病毒 ("HCV")、梅毒、地中海貧血癥與 COVID-19 的測試，這些測試可在點對點現場快速進行。這些產品銷售至美國與國際市場，包括各類臨牀實驗室、醫院、診所、社區組織、其他公共衛生機構、經銷商、政府機關、醫師診所與商業與工業機構。本公司 HIV 與 COVID-19 產品亦以消費者友善格式銷售於美國的非處方藥 ("OTC") 市場，並在其他國家以自測方式銷售給個人，包括 HIV 產品在歐洲以口腔拭子居家測試 HIV-1 與 HIV-2，以及 HCV 產品以非處方藥測試方式銷售。2025 年 12 月，本公司向美國食品藥物管理局 ("FDA") 提交預先市場通知 ("510(k)") 以取得其快速分子自測試驗，用於沙眼衣原體與淋球菌 ("CT/NG")，目前正進行審查。

本公司業務亦包含樣本管理解決方案與服務，用於臨牀實驗室、直接對消費者實驗室、研究人員、藥廠與動物健康服務與產品供應商。樣本管理解決方案的收入來自商業客戶的產品銷售與學術與研究市場的銷售。客戶涵蓋疾病風險管理、診斷、藥廠、生物科技與寵物醫療市場。本公司亦已開發用於新興微生物組市場的收集裝置，該市場專注於研究微生物組及其對人類與動物健康的影響。本公司亦擁有尿液收集裝置，可用於收集首次排尿的體積。此產品的初始銷售為研究用途，主要透過經銷商與合作夥伴在液體活檢與性傳播疾病市場進行。2025 年 12 月，本公司亦向美國食品藥物管理局 ("FDA") 提交 510(k) 以取得其 Colli-Pee® 居家尿液收集裝置的清潔許可，該裝置用於性傳播感染，目前正進行審查。
以下為本公司在傳染病與風險管理市場以及樣本管理產品的主要產品摘要：

OraQuick® 快速 HIV 測試為本公司快速點對點測試產品，用於檢測 HIV-1 與 HIV-2 抗體。此產品在北美、歐洲與某些國家以 OraQuick ADVANCE® 名稱銷售，而在其他開發中國家以 OraQuick® 名稱銷售。OraQuick ADVANCE® 測試已獲得美國食品藥物管理局 ("FDA") 的預先市場批准 ("PMA")，用於檢測口腔液、指尖全血、靜脈全血與血漿中的 HIV-1 與 HIV-2 抗體。OraQuick® 測試已獲得世界衛生組織 ("WHO") 的預先認證與註冊，用於檢測口腔液、全血（指尖與靜脈）、血清與血漿中的 HIV-1 與 HIV-2 抗體。2022 年 11 月，美國食品藥物管理局 ("FDA") 將 HIV 血清學診斷測試從 III 級分類重新分為 II 級分類，並加入特殊控制措施，降低此類裝置的監管負擔。此裝置使用多孔平面墊來收集口腔液樣本。收集後，將墊插入含有預測量開發劑液的試管中，並允許其反應。當血液樣本需測試時，使用環狀收集裝置收集一滴樣本，與開發劑液混合後，將收集墊插入溶液中，並允許測試反應。樣本與開發劑液隨後流經測試裝置，測試結果可在 20 到 40 分鐘內觀察到。OraQuick® 裝置為篩檢測試，需進行確認測試以確認初始陽性結果。此測試可供美國經美國臨牀實驗室改善法 ("CLIA") 認證的實驗室使用，以執行中度複雜測試。本公司亦已獲得 CLIA 免許，允許使用此測試於口腔液與指尖與靜脈全血。因此，此測試可由美國未經 CLIA 認證的更多機構使用，例如外展診所、社區組織與醫師診所。

The specimen and developer solution then flow through the testing device where test results are observable between 20 and 40 minutes. The OraQuick® device is a screening test and requires a confirmation test where an initial positive result is obtained. OraQuick ADVANCE® 檢測試劑亦經 CE 認證，可在歐洲及其他接受 CE 認證用以商業化之國家銷售。此產品亦已註冊可在其他國家銷售。本公司已於多個國家設有經銷商，並致力於提升此產品之知名度，並擴大其全球經銷網路。本公司亦已獲得世界衛生組織（WHO）預認證，用以出口此產品之版本。

OraQuick® HIV 自我檢測試劑為本公司 OraQuick ADVANCE® HIV 1/2 抗體檢測試劑之非處方藥（OTC）口部液體專用版本。本公司已獲得美國 FDA 發行之 PMA 許可，可在美國非處方藥市場銷售此試劑，適用年齡為 14 歲以上之個人。此試劑之操作方式與 OraQuick ADVANCE® 檢測試劑相同，唯其產品標籤與使用說明為消費者設計。OraQuick In-Home HIV 自我檢測試劑於 2024 年透過 PMA 補充申請重新品牌為 OraQuick HIV 自我檢測試劑。此外，本公司已設立免付費客戶電話支援服務，以提供消費者使用此產品之額外資訊與轉介服務。

OraQuick® HIV 自我檢測試劑（國際版）為一種居家使用之體外診斷試劑，用以檢測 HIV（HIV-1 和 HIV-2）於口部液體中，並供個人使用。OraQuick® HIV 自我檢測試劑（國際版）在某些外國國家銷售，包括在某些歐洲國家透過 CE 認證銷售，以符合這些市場之需求。此產品已獲得世界衛生組織（WHO）預認證，並符合購買新機構可從全球基金（Global Fund）、PEPFAR 及其他機構取得資金與資源之採購資格。2026 年 2 月，本公司宣佈 OraQuick® HIV 自我檢測試劑（國際版）已獲得加拿大衛生部發行之許可，可用於加拿大，並為加拿大首個口部 HIV 自我檢測試劑。
OraQuick® 平台另一項可用之試劑為 OraQuick® HCV 快速抗體試劑。此產品為一種定性試劑，可用於檢測對乙型肝炎 C 病毒（"HCV"）之抗體，於多種樣本類型中皆可使用。OraQuick® HCV 試劑之操作方式與 OraQuick ADVANCE® HIV 試劑幾乎相同。

本公司已獲得 FDA 發行之 PMA 許可與 CLIA 免許，可用於檢測 HCV 抗體於靜脈全血與指尖全血樣本中，使其成為美國首個且唯一獲得 FDA 許可可用於美國之 HCV 快速試劑。2021 年 11 月，美國 FDA 將乙型肝炎 C 病毒（HCV）抗體試劑（用以定性檢測 HCV）之分類從 Class III 調整為 Class II，並加入特殊控制措施，以降低此類裝置之監管負擔。OraQuick® HCV 試劑已獲得 CE 認證，可用於口部液體、靜脈全血、指尖全血、血漿與血清，並在歐洲銷售。此 CE 認證產品亦已註冊並在其他外國國家銷售，並已獲得世界衛生組織（WHO）預認證。
此外，OraQuick® HCV 自我檢測試劑為一種非處方藥（OTC）自我檢測試劑，可在美國以外之某些市場使用，其操作方式與 OraQuick® HCV 快速抗體試劑幾乎相同。OraQuick® HCV 自我檢測試劑於 2024 年獲得世界衛生組織（WHO）預認證，為首個獲得此認證之乙型肝炎 C 自我檢測試劑。

paragraphs: 本公司業務係開發、製造、行銷、銷售及分銷簡易且易於使用的診斷產品與樣本收集裝置，使用其專屬技術，以及其它診斷產品，包括免疫分析與其它體外診斷測試，這些測試用於其他樣本類型。本公司診斷產品包括用於快速於現場進行的疾病測試，包括艾滋病（HIV）、丙型肝炎（Hepatitis C）、梅毒、鐮狀細胞貧血及冠狀病毒（COVID-19）等疾病。這些產品銷售至美國與國際各地的各類臨牀實驗室、醫院、診所、社區組織、公共衛生機構、經銷商、政府機關、醫師診所及商業與工業機構。本公司之艾滋病及冠狀病毒（COVID-19）產品亦以消費者友善格式銷售於美國的非處方藥（OTC）市場，並在若干其它國家以自測方式銷售給個人，包括對艾滋病產品而言，在歐洲以口腔拭子在家測試 HIV-1 和 HIV-2，在對丙型肝炎（HCV）產品而言，以非處方藥測試銷售。2025 年 12 月，本公司向美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）提交了 510(k) 以取得其快速分子自測試（CT/NG）的許可，目前正進行審查。

本公司業務亦包括樣本管理解決方案與服務，用於臨牀實驗室、直接對消費者實驗室、研究人員、藥品公司及動物健康服務與產品供應商。樣本管理解決方案的收入來自對商業客戶的產品銷售及學術與研究市場的銷售。客戶涵蓋疾病風險管理、診斷、藥品、生物科技及伴侶動物市場等領域。本公司亦已開發用於新興微生物組市場的收集裝置，該市場專注於研究微生物組及其對人類與動物健康之影響。本公司亦擁有尿液收集裝置，可用於收集首次排尿的體積。此產品的初步銷售（僅限研究用途）主要透過液體活檢與性傳播疾病市場的經銷商與合作夥伴進行。2025 年 12 月，本公司亦向美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）提交了 510(k) 以取得其 Colli-Pee® 在家尿液收集裝置用於性傳播感染的許可，目前正進行審查。
2024 年第三季，本公司宣佈停止銷售其風險評估產品線，該產品線於 2025 年第二季完成停售。其風險評估產品銷售於 2025 年 12 月 31 日前十二個月及 2024 年前十二個月分別為營業收入貢獻 1.9 百萬美元及 8.4 百萬美元。2025 年第一季，本公司出售了組成其風險評估產品線的某些資產，包括某些智慧財產權、契約、許可證及設備。
2025 年 11 月，本公司收購了 BioMedomics, Inc.（"BioMedomics"），根據協議，BioMedomics 成為本公司的全資子公司。BioMedomics 的收購擴充了本公司之診斷產品組合，新增了 SickleSCAN®，這是一款快速、現場即時測試，用於診斷鐮狀細胞疾病，並在美國境外銷售。

基因體學市場的變化可能對本公司的業務產生不利影響。
本公司的未來成功取決於市場對其現有及未來產品與服務的接受度。
若對口液檢測與採集產品的接受度與採用度無法持續，本公司的未來結果可能受影響。
本公司預期將面臨來自其他診斷測試與樣本採集產品供應商的日益激烈的競爭。
本公司產品的銷售週期可能較長，且可能依賴公共資金，這可能導致本公司營運結果的變動性與不可預測性。
本公司無法拓展國際銷售的能力可能對其業務與營運結果產生不利影響。
本公司之國際佈局可能增加其風險，並使其業務面臨法規、文化或其他限制。
本公司美國政府契約需符合眾多法律，並增加其風險與責任。
本公司若無法依照適用之規格、性能標準或品質要求製造產品，將對其業務產生不利影響。
本公司之營運成果取決於其管理國內與全球供應鏈及流通渠道之能力。
本公司部分產品依賴單一來源供應商所提供之零組件，若該供應商無法提供，將使其無法交付該產品。
本公司美國政府契約可能影響其智慧財產權權利。
本公司美國政府契約及相關行政程序可能受美國聯邦政府之審計與成本調整影響。
本公司預期其 InteliSwab® COVID-19 快速測試產品之營收水準將持續下降。
醫療產業的整併可能不利於本公司未來的營業收入與營運成果。
本公司在研究、開發及商業化方面的努力可能無法成功，且其競爭對手可能開發並商業化更有效或更成功的產品。
客戶集中度為本公司業務帶來風險。
本公司面臨與政府資金及客戶訂單相關的風險。
併購或投資可能無法產生預期的效益，且可能幹擾本公司持續進行的業務，分散其管理層注意力，增加其費用，並對其業務產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 投資本公司證券涉及風險。以下為可能對 OraSure 事業、營運及財務結果產生不利影響的主要因素總覽。您在投資本公司前，應仔細考量下列風險與不確定性，並配合本年度報告中所有其他資訊，包括本公司的合併財務報表及其相關附註，以及「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」部分。此總覽並未涵蓋本公司所面臨的所有風險。有關上述風險的進一步討論，請參見本總覽之後的內容。
